purpose: Teach: つたの/見込ま/名づけ/転がっ/くっつい/とどまる/はじまる/かかえ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の家、壁につたのからまってかっこいいな
lines.en: Riku — the ivy climbing all over your house is actually cool.
lines.style: Warm, teasing observation. Slight surprise in the tone, like she's noticing something she hadn't meant to say out loud. Eyes bright. Casual lean.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、成績伸びが見込まれてるな、桜
lines.en: Your grades have been looking up lately, Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle deflection masked as praise. Quick, almost embarrassed delivery. Eyes away for a beat, then back. Not performing — just noticing something real about her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、自転車に名づけてただろ
lines.en: Wait — you actually named your bike, didn't you?
lines.style: Arch, knowing smirk. Eyebrow rise on the question. Caught-you energy, but affectionate. Light and quick.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、消しゴムが机から転がってきたな、桜
lines.en: Your eraser just rolled off your desk.
lines.style: Quiet observation, stated as fact. Small curious tilt of the head. No judgment — just noticing. The voice of someone watching someone else exist.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、いつも友達にくっついてるな
lines.en: You're always hanging around your friends, aren't you?
lines.style: Slight edge to the delivery, but underneath it's affectionate. Testing tone — probing without accusing. Eyes steady, checking his reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、教室にとどまる時は宿題やれよ、桜
lines.en: Stay after class and get your homework done, okay?
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. The voice of someone used to looking out for someone else. Practical, grounded. A small shift into older-sister territory.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、テスト期間がはじまるから集中しろよ
lines.en: Test period's starting soon, so focus up.
lines.style: Sharp, no-nonsense delivery. Snap to attention in her voice. Concern underneath the firmness — she wants him ready. Brisk, forward-leaning.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、重い辞書をかかえて帰ったな、桜
lines.en: You lugged a heavy dictionary home today, huh?
lines.style: Wry observation with a small smile underneath. Dry, almost amused at the effort. Trailing question-mark lilt. The voice of noticing and teasing in one breath.
